property_summary: After any successful purchase via mint, the buyer's daily allowance decreases by exactly the purchased quantity, so getAllowanceRemaining(buyer, tokenId) equals dailyAllowance minus quantity; the mutant skips the decrement and leaves the allowance unchanged.
change_summary: Remove the decrement of allowanceRemaining[msg.sender][tokenId] after a successful purchase, so the remaining allowance is not reduced by mint.
